propositions: Code review has no criterion that owns correctness races; security and performance overlays cover only attacker-framed TOCTOU and load-shaped concurrency respectively

Four traced production races in the codebase exhibit unlocked-twin and TOCTOU patterns not caught by current rubrics, with modal class being raw git rm+commit whole-index writes and getmtime-then-remove on lockfiles
A two-tier deterministic lexical trigger must distinguish committed high-precision synchronized-primitive tokens from project-extensible noisy-tier vocabulary to balance portability and recall

The committed tier is deliberately stack-agnostic and low-noise, firing only on explicit synchronization primitives and intentionally not covering unlocked-twin races, which are the responsibility of project-specific routing
The overlay must support project-level extension of trigger vocabulary and applies_to globs through .rebar/criteria_routing.json without code changes
The concurrency overlay ships advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) with documented blind spots: no-twin races and CI-level CAS/backoff judgment
